title: Zyros' Modpack
description:
Zyros' Modpack is a high-performance collection built for Minecraft.
This pack focuses on maximizing frames and stability while not changing the real game
body:
# About
This is **Zyros' Modpack**, inside are mods to improve your gameplay and performance all while changing nothing from the real game!

This contains things like *Optimization Mods*, and *Client-Side Mods*.

# How To Run
Requires Java 22 or above to run.


*Feel free to use this pack or feature it in videos, but do NOT reupload it without my consent!*
